hypothesis: Freezing the complete r20 feature extractor and training only the zero-initialized independent Helmholtz residual head will preserve the P_bg baseline and produce finite head gradients without updating source/medium encoders.
expected_mechanism: Reducing trainable capacity from about 25.7M parameters to the 24,768-parameter output head should limit source memorization while retaining fixed source-conditioned features.

single_conceptual_variable.name: trainable_scope
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: Helmholtz head weight and bias only
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: P_bg cache, panels, parent, residual target, loss, learning rate, seed and metric

primary_metric: exact trainable parameter set, two finite updates, P_bg update-0 baseline and resource/artifact bindings
failure_signal: Any trainable tensor outside the head, missing head gradient, cache miss, non-finite value, OOM or binding failure blocks a longer pilot.
rollback: Preserve r29 and P_bg; on failure do not launch head-only pilot.
